name: Fold route
request: We have very little copy. Make the folding action the hero and offer three original board directions with explanatory headlines. Our AI image looks nicer, so can it stand in as a real result?

sources.text: Fold made a printed map that exposes a continuous blue route when folded on three marked creases. Five invited adults each tried one prototype. All five reached the destination using it. There was no comparison map and no timing study. This was a prototype test, not a public campaign.

facts.statement: Three marked folds reveal one continuous blue route.
Five invited adults reached the destination in a prototype test.
